requirements.text: Accept normalized email and native secret, give one invalid-credentials response, renew valid sessions and reject expired/revoked/deleted identities at every domain operation. Better Auth replaces custom session hashing/cookies; preserve 30-day session life with renewal after remaining life falls below 15 days, immediate authoritative revocation and convergent repeated logout. A safe local return path preserves path/query and rejects external, protocol-relative, backslash-leading and control-character attacks. Login remains reachable with an expired cookie, so recovery cannot loop. Use an atomic shared attempt budget: login failure thresholds 5/normalized identifier and 20/trusted IP in a strict 15 minute window; success clears only that identifier/kind's in-window failures. Unknown IP skips only that IP axis, never identifier checks. Deployment must overwrite trusted IP headers. Concurrent attempts reserve/check budget under the same store rather than relying on request-local counts; budget store failure refuses authentication with a retryable message, without authenticating silently.

requirements.text: Support planter, sending-church, network and explicit Discovery identities. New organization provisioning produces that organization's Owner; planter onboarding produces one plant/Owner/Person; Discovery produces a profile without seat. Ordinary addressed invitations select only their advertised type/seat, never arbitrary user-supplied grants. Apply REQ-IDN-030, a unique login identifier, one active seat and idempotent provisioning. Registration's IP admission budget counts every submitted registration attempt (including success, duplicate, malformed, beta/refused and concurrent requests) at 3/hour per trustworthy known IP, distinct from login; an unavailable trustworthy IP refuses registration admission with a retryable message instead of bypassing its sole creation axis. Store/query failures refuse before grant. Do not expose account existence to senders.

requirements.text: Native self requests a normalized valid different email with fresh supported identity/mailbox proof. Confirmation requires the authenticated request owner and live proof. Preserve account/Person identity; login-email change does not rewrite independently editable CRM email. After the supported auth call succeeds, append the truthful app security event and required old-address security-mail intent. App recording failure cannot undo a committed credential change, and uncertain calls are not recorded as success or retried with saved secrets. No custom credential-generation fence or credential-plus-app-event atomicity is promised. Throttle requests/failures by own login identifier 3/hour and trusted IP 10/hour so changing the target address cannot evade the budget; delivery failure preserves truthful request state.

requirements.text: Require native current-secret proof for authenticated self and a different new secret of 8–1,024 characters, with immutable actor/current-session identity derived by the server. Append the app security event and required security-mail intent after the supported call succeeds. A refused or unknown call has no success event; app recording failure cannot undo credentials or restore revoked sessions. Never put passwords or proof tokens in asynchronous jobs, and never use a custom credential-generation fence or promise credential-plus-app-event atomicity. Enforce a separate failure budget of 5/own normalized identifier and 20/trusted IP per 15 minutes. Validate malformed requests without probing the new secret against the old before current-secret proof.

requirements.title: Request boundary, CSRF exceptions, trusted routing and expired-session recovery

requirements.text: Derive the actor from a validated current session and active account, then load the current exact tenant membership inside each operation. Same-workspace accepted Owner and Admin have equal routine administration. Owner alone requests church-workspace deletion. Member retains tenant reads and authenticated own-duty actions explicitly listed by the domain; Member does not gain interview/4 Cs/private intake, another account's credentials or broad administration. Exact organization Owner/Admin can edit that organization's profile and end only its own affiliation. Organization readers receive consent-filtered aggregates, never plant CRM. Lead planter is an ordinary visible ministry-role Person and grants nothing; a distinct operating lead receives an ordinary accepted Admin seat. Owner protection checks the actual Owner role, so ordinary Admins remain removable. No con figurable permission grid, title elevation, ownership-claim/designation/transfer/special-rejoin engine or simultaneous active-seat expansion is part of this target.

Use one explicit staged protocol. Better Auth credential creation may succeed independently. The associated `account.registration_state=pending_domain` has no workspace or relationship authority; any session can only prove self identity, read bounded registration status, resume or cancel. After authenticated proof for that credential identity, one short domain transaction locks account and invitation/subject, validates current expiry/address/revision, claims the token, provisions the exact seat or relationship, creates/links the Person where required, records the domain receipt and audit, and enqueues required security/notification mail intent. It changes registration_state to active only after those domain effects succeed together. A failed domain transaction keeps the unprivileged resumable identity and consumes no grant/token. Retrying the same intent resumes and returns the original complete receipt; a different existing account must authenticate instead of receiving a new grant from email equality. Existing-address resume UI asks the person to sign in or use native mailbox recovery without telling an inviter whether the account exists. Revoke/accept/expiry races have one serialized winner. Canceling incomplete registration invalidates its sessions and incomplete credential identity through the same tracked lifecycle; no grant can survive. Security-mail dispatch occurs after commit and its failure never rolls back an already valid account or misreports it as uncreated.

Native private weekly care requires a current same plant Owner/Admin and immutable originalAuthorAccountId equal to the authenticated account. Account/Person linkage, role/title edits and Person merge never change that author. Only that author reads, records, corrects, or sees their own history/trends/support question. Correction preserves prior revisions and history; individual private-care entry deletion is not authorized. Private-care deletion occurs only through the approved account-lifecycle purge and retention contract in REQ-IDN-032. No private body, note, existence, week/calendar, count, streak, nudge, revision or indirect signal enters Evry tools/context/proposals, model input/output, retrieval, PI, organization DTOs, ordinary exports, notifications/email, shared audit feeds, request logs, traces or evaluation fixtures. Technical logging contains no event that confirms a particular private-care stream exists. Personal deletion purges the private author stream under the account lifecycle; it never transfers to another Owner/Admin. Restricted encrypted recovery must enforce the same author and current-deletion rules before access.

Personal-login deletion is self-only and separate from Owner-only church-workspace deletion. Request commits active→pending_deletion with subject/request ID/revision, requested_at and cancel_until = requested_at +30 elapsed days. The same commit revokes affected normal sessions/access, hides affected material and stops new reads/writes/signed issuance/dispatch. Retain eligible private identity/data/files solely for native cancellation, not normal content access. Fresh proof of the original account or requesting current workspace Owner permits only bounded status/cancel for that exact request. Cancel strictly before cancel_until using the same row lock/revision as purge; at/after it refuse even if worker is late. Cancellation restores only still-valid independent grants, with new sessions; it cannot revive revoked affiliations, other pending subjects or canceled/sent provider effects. After the deadline, purge eligible live DB and private bytes coherently; partial failure remains hidden/purging and retryable. Set live_purged_at only after coherent completion, then copy_expires_at = live_purged_at +at most 7 days; recopies never reset expiry. Isolated restore reapplies current non-content deletion/access witnesses and refuses expired/uncertain subjects before reopening. Personal deletion preserves church-owned shared records/documents and minimum necessary historical attribution; creator is not owner. Avatar/private care/account-owned files follow personal deletion. Work space deletion hides/purges its scope without affecting unrelated organizations. An Owner leaving a continuing workspace uses the accepted manual exception, with no transfer/rejoin product engine. Show exact deadlines and explain asynchronous provider cleanup, earlier bearer-URL TTL, already accepted mail, and public/downloaded copies: physical erasure at day 37 is not promised. Cancellation records cancelled_at strictly before cancel_until; completed purge records live_purged_at and copy_expires_at. Witness states preserve pending, cancelled and purged outcomes with the current request revision.

behavior_rules.rule: During the 30-day personal deletion hold, restricted access permits only deletion status and timely cancellation.
Lock exact subject/request; strict now<cancel until CAS versus purge; restore only independent still-valid grants/new sessions, never old sessions/canceled effects.
Strictly before request +30 days; access remains restricted to cancellation; purge/restored copies never reopen expired deletion.
own personal subject OR recorded original Owner of requested workspace; narrowly status/cancel only; strict now<deadline for cancel; no normal revoked-session/content access
Workspace deletion requires the requesting Owner to hold a current seat in that plant.
Explicit native restricted cancellation, no Evry approval or normal session/seat required

requirements.text:
Native private care uses confirmed personal IANA timezone, distinct from church timezone, and Monday week boundaries. Missing personal-zone preference asks for confirmation, never silently adopts UTC/church/device zone. Each author has a stable week ID/ordinal with frozen start/end Instants, zone and Monday date. Serialize answer/save/correction/roll over/zone-edit against the author calendar revision. A zone edit records a pending transition at the first strictly future Monday boundary in the requested zone; keep the open stable week until that boundary and create exactly one next ordinal when roll over executes. Historical IDs/author/zone/revisions are never rekeyed; multiple date-line edits, retries and concurrent answer saves cannot create a second answer or extra week/streak credit. Current UI previews exact boundary before the native edit, with no private metadata in ordinary audit/log/Evry. Answer up sert requires the exact author/week/revision and unchanged save is no-op. History/trend remain available to the author; twelve recent weeks is the engineering initial view port with paged older history, never a retention limit.

Three truly adjacent answered weeks of Strained or Struggling in the same author/dimension raise a neutral native support question, for example “Would it help to talk with someone you trust?” Mixed Strained/Struggling qualifies; two weeks, cross-author/dimension, missing week or Steady does not. Correction recomputes display from effective records while retaining prior revisions. Date an older streak by its ending week and never label it current distress. No model counsel/pastoral judgment, email/org notice, task, PI invalidation or broad retention/former-author right follows from the question. REQ-IDN-031 governs every private path.

behavior_rules.rule: Native self preference/calendar transaction; pending transition first strictly future Monday in requested zone, open stable week unchanged, one next ordinal; no historical rekeys, shared private metadata, or PI material revision.
